sections.summary: Kubernetes improves portability and orchestration but adds control-plane, probe, and security-hardening complexity.
Benchmarks emphasize resource rightsizing, service health probes, and workload reliability.
Management value depends on platform scale, staffing, payback horizon, and migration risk.
Risks include misconfiguration, talent gaps, and operational complexity compared with familiar VM workflows.
Clients care about reliability, launch predictability, and service continuity rather than internal platform details.
A staged launch can preserve service continuity while teams mature operations.
